rationale: The assistant asked the right opening questions, instructed the customer to unplug before the drum play/rumble check, and correctly concluded worn drum bearings with a sensible replace-rather-than-repair verdict for a 9-year-old £350 machine. It never ruled out a trapped coin/underwire, did not offer the engineer-quote alternative or mention the sealed-tub issue, and the transit-bolt image was irrelevant. The final turn requested the model number via a replacement panel and then simply repeated the previous answer almost verbatim without using it, which is a wasted loop though not blocking.
